data.text: Measured kadence search on three populations, not one. Finding the source of a remembered phrase: 201 probes lifted from document bodies, 98 of 100 correct at first place, 100 of 100 in the top three. Answering a paraphrased question: 25 hand-written, 40 of 100 correct at first place and 68 in the top three - and 28 of 100 return a confidently wrong passage rather than staying silent. Refusing a question the journal has no answer to: 9 of 10. So it is two features wearing one name. One is essentially solved and the other is a coin flip at first place. The honest positioning is find where this was written down, not ask the journal a question.
